# Bundled fonts

- `sixtyfour-variable.woff2` comes from [jenskutilek/homecomputer-fonts](https://github.com/jenskutilek/homecomputer-fonts), the Sixtyfour variable font. License: `OFL-Sixtyfour.txt`.
- `qiu-ye-yuan-ti-16.ttf` comes from [yzdnn/QiuYeYuanTi-16](https://github.com/yzdnn/QiuYeYuanTi-16), 秋叶圆体 16. License: `OFL-QiuYeYuanTi-16.txt`.
- `IBMPlexSansSC-Regular.woff2` and `IBMPlexSansSC-SemiBold.woff2` come from [IBM/plex](https://github.com/IBM/plex/tree/master/packages/plex-sans-sc). License: `OFL-IBMPlexSansSC.txt`.
- `IBMPlexMono-Regular.woff2` comes from [IBM/plex](https://github.com/IBM/plex/tree/master/packages/plex-mono). License: `OFL-IBMPlexMono.txt`.

The original font files are bundled without modification. Keep the accompanying licenses with the font files when redistributing the app.
